integrity: The finite checker exhausts type-universe sizes at most three; the universal theorem, exact formulas and asymptotics use a written symbolic proof. Historic priority is not independently certified. No external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only single-agent S5, finite Boolean propositional vocabulary, ordinary world-deleting truthful announcements of a static formula. Uniformity is over semantic equivalence classes, not syntactic strings. Fixed-support one-half probability is not a simultaneous multi-class probability.
title: An exact extinction dichotomy for uniformly sampled one-agent S5 announcements
